title: Total Lunar Eclipse to Turn Moon Red
credits: Adithi Ramakrishnan wrote this story for The Associated Press. Andrew Smith adapted it for VOA Learning English.

sentences.en: A total lunar eclipse is about to make the moon appear a reddish color across the Western Hemisphere.
sentences.zh: 一场月全食即将让月球在西半球呈现出红色。

sentences.en: The event will happen Thursday night into Friday morning.
sentences.zh: 这一天象将于周四夜间延续至周五清晨发生。

sentences.en: The best places to see the eclipse will be in North America and South America.
sentences.zh: 观赏这次月食的最佳地点将位于北美洲和南美洲。

sentences.en: Parts of Africa and Europe may also get brief views.
sentences.zh: 非洲和欧洲的部分地区或许也能短暂地看到。

sentences.en: A lunar eclipse happens when the sun, Earth, and moon line up just right, with Earth positioned between the sun and moon.
sentences.zh: 月食发生时，太阳、地球和月球恰好排成一条直线，地球位于太阳和月球之间。

sentences.en: This causes the Earth to create a shadow on the moon.
sentences.zh: 这导致地球在月球上投下阴影。

sentences.en: In a total lunar eclipse, the Earth’s shadow covers all of the moon.
sentences.zh: 在月全食中，地球的阴影会完全覆盖月球。

sentences.en: Another kind of eclipse is a solar eclipse.
sentences.zh: 另一种日食是日食。

sentences.en: In a solar eclipse, the moon gets in a position where it blocks light from the sun, causing a partial or full shadow on Earth.
sentences.zh: 在日食中，月球运行到遮挡太阳光的位置，从而在地球上形成部分或完全的阴影。

sentences.en: A total lunar eclipse can also be called a blood moon.
sentences.zh: 月全食也可以被称为'血月'。

sentences.en: It makes the moon appear reddish-orange, similar to the element copper.
sentences.zh: 它让月球呈现出红橙色，类似于铜这种元素。

sentences.en: The color comes from small amounts of sunlight passing through the Earth’s atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 这种颜色来自少量穿过地球大气层的阳光。

sentences.en: The American space agency NASA says lunar and solar eclipses happen between four and seven times a year.
sentences.zh: 美国航天局NASA表示，月食和日食每年发生四到七次。

sentences.en: The last total lunar eclipse was in 2022.
sentences.zh: 上一次月全食出现在2022年。

sentences.en: This one will be visible for about one hour starting Friday morning at 2:26 a.m. Eastern Daylight Time (EDT).
sentences.zh: 这次月食将从周五清晨2点26分（美东夏令时，EDT）开始，大约持续一小时可见。

sentences.en: The time when the Earth’s shadow covers all of the moon will be close to 3 a.m. EDT.
sentences.zh: 地球阴影完全覆盖月球的时间将在东部夏令时凌晨3点左右。

sentences.en: “As long as the sky is clear, you should be able to see it,” Shannon Schmoll told the Associated Press.
sentences.zh: '只要天空晴朗，你应该就能看到它，'香农·施莫尔告诉美联社。

sentences.en: She is the director of Abrams Planetarium at Michigan State University.
sentences.zh: 她是密歇根州立大学阿布拉姆斯天文馆的馆长。

sentences.en: No special equipment will be needed to see the reddish moon.
sentences.zh: 观看这轮红色的月球无需任何特殊设备。

sentences.en: The total lunar eclipse may be harder to see in Europe and Africa because the moon will be close to setting.
sentences.zh: 由于月球接近落山，这次月全食在欧洲和非洲可能更难观测。

sentences.en: Michael Faison is an astronomy expert from Yale University.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·费尔森是耶鲁大学的天文学专家。

sentences.en: He told the AP, “This is really an eclipse for North and South America.”
sentences.zh: 他告诉美联社：'这真是一场属于北美和南美的日食。'

sentences.en: Zoe Ortiz is a historian with the University of North Texas.
sentences.zh: 佐伊·奥蒂兹是北德克萨斯大学的历史学家。

sentences.en: She noted that different civilizations have observed lunar eclipses for thousands of years.
sentences.zh: 她指出，不同的文明已经观测月食数千年了。

sentences.en: This helped ancient people learn things about the behaviors of the sun, moon, and stars.
sentences.zh: 这帮助古人了解了关于太阳、月亮和星星运行规律的知识。

sentences.en: “They were looking at the night sky and they had a much brighter vision than we do today,” Ortiz said.
sentences.zh: '他们仰望夜空，拥有的视野远比我们今天更加开阔，'奥蒂兹说。

sentences.en: The ancient Greek thinker and writer Aristotle observed that Earths’ shadow on the moon during a lunar eclipse was always curved.
sentences.zh: 古希腊思想家和亚里士多德观察到，在月食期间地球在月亮上的影子始终是弯曲的。

sentences.en: This fact supported proof that the Earth is round.
sentences.zh: 这一事实为地球是圆形的提供了佐证。

sentences.en: The next total lunar eclipse will appear in the sky September 7, across parts of Asia, Africa, Australia and Europe.
sentences.zh: 下一次月全将出现在9月7日的天空中，横跨亚洲、非洲、澳大利亚和欧洲的部分地区。

sentences.en: Parts of the Americas will get the next chance to see one in March 2026.
sentences.zh: 美洲的部分地区将在2026年3月迎来下一次观赏的机会。

sentences.en: I’m Caty Weaver.
sentences.zh: 我是凯蒂·韦弗。

glossary.def: a dark area created by something blocking light
a line that bends around in the same way as a circle
